notes: Same real AE NetworkMonitor/NetworkInventoryHandler and native Universe media. Plain AE has no public storage wrapper or allocator; no cable/world tick, security host, listeners, telemetry or external inventories. Same JVM includes Futa mixins in every arm. Synthetic isolated timings, not a TPS or full-server comparison. All resources in multi-type fixtures carry NBT; raw requests are prebuilt, copied by actual engine as needed. A roundtrip is one extraction plus one matching insertion.

migration.notes: Separate one-shot measurements of in-memory conversion and real on-disk NativeMeMigration.load (backup/hash/fsync/remount verification/atomic ownership commit). Startup validates the original backup before native load. Under build/ only; these are not warm percentile measurements.
